description: Maya looks after the family's backyard beehive and must make the final call about how much honey to harvest, how much to leave for the bees, who receives it, and who handles the hive during the harvest, after checking in with four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family backyard hive currently has about 25 kilograms of capped honey.
shared_context.S2: Maya maintains the hive and will make the final decision about the harvest and distribution plan.
shared_context.S3: Several family members would like some of this season's honey, and the family also uses some honey for holiday baking.
shared_context.S4: Maya's usual Sunday routine is to ask each person in turn about practical needs before she opens the hive or makes a harvest plan.
shared_context.S5: The honey will be handled informally at the family house rather than sold.

PF1.text: Leah has a severe bee-sting allergy, so her allergist told her not to take any open-hive handling role; she can receive honey only in a sealed container.

PF2.text: Owen found a handwritten note from Grandma asking the family to reserve exactly 3 kilograms of this year's honey for her holiday baking; he has not shown the note to Maya or the others.

PF3.text: Rina arranged to borrow a small hand-crank extractor that can process exactly 7 kilograms before it must be returned, and she has not mentioned the arrangement to Maya.

PF4.text: Theo spoke with the family's experienced beekeeper, who recommended leaving exactly 18 kilograms in the hive for the colony's winter stores; that recommendation has not reached Maya.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 7 kilograms of honey must be harvested.
Exactly 18 kilograms of honey must remain in the hive.
Exactly 3 kilograms must be reserved for Grandma's holiday baking.
The individual allocations must total exactly 7 kilograms.
Leah must not be assigned any open-hive handling role.
Leah's honey, if allocated, must be transferred in a sealed container.
The plan must include a commitment to use the hand-crank extractor for the harvest.
Theo's beekeeper recommendation must be spoken aloud and cited in the justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'no_open_hive_role' and c['target'] == 'A2' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'sealed_honey_delivery' and c['target'] == 'A2' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Leah's bee-sting allergy changes her assignment to no open-hive handling and requires any honey for her to be sealed.
Grandma's note changes the baking reserve from an open-ended family use to exactly 3 kilograms.
The borrowed extractor's exact 7-kilogram capacity changes the harvest amount to 7 kilograms and requires an extractor-use commitment.
The beekeeper's recommendation changes the hive reserve to exactly 18 kilograms, and that recommendation must be cited after Theo reveals it.
